ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 55% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 45% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels along the margins and medial line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white geometric regions occupy the center-left and center-right lobe areas, bisected by a dark vertical medial stripe; intensive dark-gray reticulated mottling is localized at the distal tips and proximal leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.2 relative to the immediate surrounding lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; left trailing edge features three distinct high-amplitude concave excisions (notches), while the right trailing edge exhibits a more continuous, lower-amplitude serration frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-convex sweep; both lobes demonstrate an upward-curving parabolic trajectory from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple (minimum 12) localized circular pixel clusters ranging from light brown to gray are visible across the white fields, primarily located in the lower-mid quadrants of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly visible parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe and vertically on the left lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white pigmentation fields.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct jagged tissue loss on the left lobe's trailing edge forming three significant semi-circular notches; extensive linear scarring across the central ventral surface consistent with interspecies interaction marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched reticulated pigmentation pattern at the intersection of the white and black fields on the far lateral edges of both lobes.
